description.en: An end-to-end ONNX quantization benchmark for a DistilBERT sentiment classifier, comparing PyTorch FP32, ONNX FP32, dynamic INT8, and static INT8 variants on accuracy, latency, and model size using a fixed 200-sample SST-2 validation set.

attentionForecast.reason: The DistilBERT quantization comparison is a common educational and deployment topic, but its single-model scope is unlikely to generate significant early interest.

curation.canonicalNameEvidence: # DistilBERT ONNX Quantization Benchmark End-to-end model optimization pipeline for a DistilBERT sentiment classifier: PyTorch to ONNX export, dynamic INT8 quantization, and static (calibration-based) INT8 quantization, with accuracy, latency, and size benchmarked at every step on a fixed evaluation set.
curation.decisionReason: Primary-source review: this is a single DistilBERT quantization experiment on 200 existing SST-2 examples, not a new reusable benchmark family.

evaluationEvidence.reuse: Reproduce Run in order in Google Colab: 1. `baseline.py` - load model, establish FP32 accuracy/latency/size baseline 2. `onnx_export.py` - export to ONNX, verify correctness vs. PyTorch 3. `reshape_sizes.py` - fix a size-measurement bug (ONNX external data file) 4. `dynamic_quantization.py` - dynamic INT8 quantization + benchmark 5. `static_quantization.py` - static INT8 quantization + benchmark
evaluationEvidence.scoring: | Variant | Accuracy | Latency (mean) | Latency (p95) | Size | |---|---|---|---|---| | PyTorch FP32 | 91.0% | 94.7ms | 207.2ms | 255.4MB | | ONNX Runtime FP32 | 91.0% | 43.8ms | 61.4ms | 256.2MB | | ONNX Dynamic INT8 | 90.0% | 22.4ms | 26.0ms | 64.7MB | | ONNX Static INT8 | 89.0% | 37.7ms | 68.4ms | 134.7MB |
